mapper.select: select teacher.id as teacherId, teacher.name as teacherName, course.id as courseId, course.title as courseTitle, course.lesson_num as courseLessonNum, course.status as courseStatus, course.view_count as courseViewCount, course.buy_count as courseBuyCount, course.cover as courseCover, course.price as coursePrice, course.create_time as courseCreateTime, course.update_time as courseUpdateTime, chapter.id as chapterId, chapter.title as chapterTitle, chapter.sort as chapterSort, chapter.update_time as chapterUpdateTime, chapter.create_time as chapterCreateTime from edu_chapter chapter left join edu_course course on chapter.course_id = course.id left join edu_teacher teacher on course.teacher_id = teacher.id where chapter.is_deleted = 0 order by course.title,teacher.name,chapter.sort
